in_sanskrit.name: अयनन्त
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Ayanant' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'अयन' (Ayan) which means 'endless' or 'infinite'. The suffix '-न्त' (Ant) is added to the name to denote 'that which is' or 'he who is'. Thus, the name Ayanant means 'He who is infinite' or 'The endless one'.

in_hindi.name: अयनन्त
